blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Single-image, multi-image, and video deep research require different visual operations but share a workflow of visual grounding, external retrieval, and fact composition. A key challenge is to preserve the dependencies linking localized visual anchors, entity relations, source-supported facts, and answer-producing operations. We introduce OneSearch-VL, a unified agent centered on the Visually Grounded Evidence Graph (VGEG), which encodes these dependencies as a shared task-level reference for data construction, process supervision, and operation-level evaluation. Our VGEG-based data engine constructs and verifies multi-image and video questions and filters expert trajectories. Using these data, we assemble OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K and OneSearch-VL-RL-10K for SFT and RL, respectively. We further derive the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR) from VGEG annotations to supervise evidence traceability and visual grounding during RL. For fine-grained evaluation, we construct OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench, organizing questions by the research operations encoded in their VGEGs. Experiments show that OneSearch-VL-8B improves over Qwen3-VL-8B with tool access by 20.2 and 17.6 percentage points on the two new benchmarks, respectively, while also achieving substantial gains across 7 image benchmarks and VideoDR. Project repository: https://github.com/appletea233/OneSearch-VL
blocks.zh: 单图像,多图像,视频深层研究需要不同的视觉操作,但共享视觉地面,外部检索,以及事实构成的工作流程. 关键的挑战是如何维持连接本地视觉主播、实体关系、来源支持的事实和生成答案的操作的依赖性。 我们引入了OneSearch-VL,一个以视基证据图(VGEG)为中心的统一代理,将这些依赖性编码为数据构建,过程监督和操作级评价的共同任务级参考. 我们基于VGEG的数据引擎构建并验证多图像和视频问题,过滤专家轨迹. 利用这些数据,我们分别为SFT和RL组装了OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K和OneSearch-VL-RL-10K. 我们进一步从VGEG说明中得出了证据意识的视觉-圆形Rubric奖(EVGR),以监督证据的可追踪性和RL期间的视觉定位。 为了进行精细的评价,我们构建了OneSearch-MI-Bench和OneSearch-Video-Bench,组织在他们的VGEG中编码的研究操作的提问. 实验显示,OneSearch-VL-8B比Quen3-VL-8B改进,在两个新基准上,工具访问率分别提高了20.2%和17.6个百分点,同时在7个图像基准和视频数据库上也取得了显著进展。 项目存放处:https://github.com/appletea233/OneSearch-VL

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal deep research enables vision-language models to move beyond direct answering by actively locating visual clues, retrieving external knowledge, and integrating evidence through multi-turn tool use ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Recent work has extended this capability from images to videos by combining temporal localization, visual inspection, and open-web retrieval ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) . Meanwhile, unified multimodal models extend spatial-temporal understanding and reasoning across images and videos ( Li et al., 2025a ; Feng et al., 2025b ) . These advances raise a natural question: can one policy jointly learn deep research over both images and videos? Although these settings require different visual operations, they share a workflow from visual grounding to external search and fact composition, motivating unified training across multiple visual input types.
blocks.zh: 多种模式的深入研究使视觉语言模型能够超越直接回答,积极定位视觉线索,检索外部知识,并通过多回合工具使用整合证据(Wu等,2025;Geng等,2025a; 黄等,2026;陈等,2026. 最近的工作通过结合时间定位、视觉检查和开放网检索,将这种能力从图像扩大到视频(刘等,2026;高等等,2026;方等,2026)。 同时,统一的多模式模型将空间-时空理解和推理扩展到图像和视频之间(Li等,2025a; 冯等, 2025b.). 这些进步提出了一个自然的问题:一项政策能否通过图像和视频共同学习深入研究? 虽然这些设置需要不同的视觉操作,但它们共享一个从视觉地平面到外部搜索和事实构成的工作流程,激发了多种视觉输入类型的统一培训.

blocks.en: Moving beyond prior work that primarily considers single-image or video inputs, we additionally study multi-image deep research and develop a unified framework spanning all three visual input types. Training data for this unified setting must link visual entities distributed across regions, images, or frames with relevant facts scattered across webpages. Prior work represents evidence through perception–knowledge chains, factual rubrics, and evidence graphs for task construction, supervision, and evaluation ( Jiao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . However, these structures do not jointly preserve the dependencies from localized visual anchors, through entity relations and source-supported facts, to answer composition. Video-centric pipelines similarly use extracted entities or key-frame crops mainly as retrieval or question-generation seeds ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) , without explicitly retaining this end-to-end provenance.
blocks.zh: 超越以前主要考虑单相或视频输入的工作,我们进一步研究多相相深度研究,并开发涵盖所有三种视觉输入类型的统一框架. 这种统一设置的培训数据必须把分布在各区域的视觉实体、图像或框架同散布在网页上的相关事实联系起来。 先前的工作通过认知链、事实标题、以及任务构建、监督和评价的证据图表(Jiao等,2026;Zhang等,2026;Xu等,2026;Sun等,2026)。 然而,这些结构并没有通过实体关系和来源支持的事实,共同保护依赖性,使其不受局部视觉锚地的影响,以回答组成问题。 以视频为中心的管道同样将取出的实体或关键框架作物主要用作取回或出问题种子(Gao等,2026;Fang等,2026),但没有明确保留这种端到端出处.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce the Visually Grounded Evidence Graph (VGEG) , a unified task-level reference structure for single-image, multi-image, and video research. VGEG links localized visual anchors to real-world entities, records multi-hop relational paths and source-supported facts, and specifies the operations that compose these facts into an answer. Based on VGEG, we develop a data engine for single-image, multi-image and video research that extracts visual entities, retrieves and verifies web facts, generates compositional questions, and synthesizes expert tool-use trajectories while retaining visual locations, source provenance, and evidence dependencies. These retained dependencies support question-answer construction and verification, expert-trajectory filtering, fine-grained trajectory rewards for RL, and operation-level evaluation. With this data engine, we construct OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K and OneSearch-VL-RL-10K for SFT and RL.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了可视地证据图(VGEG),这是单一图像、多图像和视频研究的统一任务级参考结构。 VGEG将本地化的可视化主机连接到现实世界实体,记录多跳关系路径和源支持的事实,并指定将这些事实编成答案的操作. 基于VGEG,我们开发了用于单相图像,多相图像和视频研究的数据引擎,可以提取视觉实体,检索并验证网络事实,生成组成问题,并综合专家工具使用轨迹,同时保留视觉位置,源出地和证据依赖性. 这些保留依赖性支持了问答构建和核查、专家-导出过滤、RL的精细轨迹奖励以及操作级评价。 通过这个数据引擎,我们构建了OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K和OneSearch-VL-RL-10K,用于SFT和RL.

blocks.en: Using these data, we develop OneSearch-VL , a unified agent trained on data spanning single-image, multi-image, and video inputs through SFT and RL. Existing multimodal agents supervise search through outcome rewards, query-quality signals, tool-use objectives, intermediate entity anchors, or evidence rubrics. We further introduce the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR) , constructed from our VGEG annotations to evaluate complete trajectories along two complementary dimensions: evidence traceability , which verifies whether the required facts are supported by tool observations, and visual grounding , which verifies whether the relevant objects, regions, or frames are correctly identified and used in the solution.
blocks.zh: 利用这些数据,我们开发了OneSearch-VL,这是一个统一的代理,通过SFT和RL对跨越单相像,多相像的数据和视频输入进行了培训. 现有的多式联运代理人通过结果奖励、查询质量信号、工具使用目标、中间实体锚地或证据来监督搜索。 我们进一步引入了证据意识视觉-轮廓Rubric奖(EVGR),该奖项是根据我们的VGEG说明构建的,旨在评价两个互补维度的完整轨迹:证据可追溯性,它验证所需事实是否得到工具观测的支持;以及视觉地平面,它验证相关物体、区域或框架是否被正确识别和用于解决方案。

blocks.en:
For fine-grained evaluation, we also introduce OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench . Existing video deep-research benchmarks primarily evaluate answer accuracy, with analyses commonly organized around video content or source categories ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) .
Our benchmarks instead organize questions according to the research operations represented in their corresponding VGEGs, which capture the entity-relation paths and fact-composition dependencies required to derive the answer. This organization emphasizes how an agent retrieves and composes evidence rather than what the visual input contains.
blocks.zh:
也引入了OneSearch-MI-Bench和OneSearch-Video-Bench。 现有视频深度研究基准主要评价答案准确性,分析通常围绕视频内容或源类别进行(Liu等,2026;Gao等,2026).
相反,我们的基准是根据对应的VGEG表示的研究行动来组织问题,这些研究行动捕捉得出答案所需的实体关系路径和事实组合依赖。 这个组织强调代理人如何取出并作成证据,而不是视觉输入的内容.

blocks.en: We evaluate OneSearch-VL on established and two new benchmarks. OneSearch-VL-8B outperforms Qwen3-VL-8B by 20.2, 17.6, and 27.0 points on OneSearch-MI-Bench, OneSearch-Video-Bench, and VideoDR, respectively. Joint SFT on all three visual input types achieves a six-benchmark average of 55.8, versus 51.7-55.1 for single-type training. EVGR further raises the average from 57.3 to 61.1 over answer and query rewards.
blocks.zh: 我们根据既定的基准和两项新基准来评估 " 一个搜索者 " -- -- VL。 OneSearch-VL-8B在OneSearch-MI-Bench,OneSearch-Video-Bench和VideoDR上分别以20.2分,17.6分和27.0分的成绩超越了Qune3-VL-8B. 所有三种视觉输入型号的联合SFT均能实现6个基准平均55.8分,而单型训练则为51.7-55.1分. EVGR将答复和查询奖励的平均数从57.3提高到61.1。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • VGEG-centered data engine. We propose VGEG, a unified structure linking visual anchors, source-supported facts, and answer composition, together with a data engine for constructing and verifying multi-image and video questions and expert trajectories. • Unified agent and evidence supervision. We develop OneSearch-VL for joint single-image, multi-image, and video deep research, and use EVGR to incorporate evidence traceability and visual grounding into RL. • Operation-oriented benchmark. We construct OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench benchmarks spanning research operations for fine-grained evaluation of fact retrieval and composition.
blocks.zh: • 以VGEG为中心的数据引擎。 我们提出VGEG,一个连接视觉锚地,源支持的事实,和答案构成的统一结构,以及构建和验证多图像和视频问题和专家轨迹的数据引擎. • 统一代理人和证据监督。 我们开发了OneSearch-VL,用于联合的单相图像,多相图像和视频的深度研究,并使用EVGR将证据可追溯性和可视地定位纳入RL. • 面向行动的基准。 我们构建了OneSearch-MI-Bench和OneSearch-Video-Bench的基准,涵盖研究业务,对事实检索和构成进行精细评价。

blocks.en: 3.1 Visual Source Curation
blocks.zh: 3.1 视觉源代码

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 (a), we first curate source videos that contain identifiable entities, concrete event cues, and sufficient potential for external knowledge retrieval. The pipeline combines metadata screening, task-suitability assessment, category balancing, and duration balancing, reducing the initial pool of 2.5M web videos to 70k candidates. See Appendix A.1 for details.
blocks.zh: 如图1(a)所示,我们首先整理包含可识别实体、具体事件提示和足够潜力的外部知识检索的原始视频。 管道将元数据筛选、任务适用性评估、类别平衡和持续时间平衡结合起来,将最初的2.5M网络视频库减少到70克候选人。 详情见附录A.1。

blocks.en: 3.2 Dense Visual Anchor Discovery
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 Dense Visual Anchor 发现

blocks.en: Figure 1 (b) converts each retained video into a hierarchical visual representation. We sample and group frames into local clips, generate clip- and frame-level descriptions, remove redundant key frames, aggregate temporally related clips into events, and localize searchable objects in representative frames. The resulting dense caption tree links each event to its temporal range, key frames, and localized object instances, which serve as visual anchors for subsequent retrieval. See Appendix A.2 for details.
blocks.zh: 图1(b) 将每个保留录像转换成分级视觉表现。 我们把相框样本和组合成本地相片,生成相片和相片级描述,去掉冗余的密钥相框,将时间相关的相片相集成事件,并在代表性相框中将可搜索对象本地化. 由此产生的稠密字幕树将每个事件连接到其时间范围,密钥框架,以及本地化的对象实例,它们充当了随后检索的可视锚. 详情见附录A.2。

blocks.en: 3.3 Web Evidence Graph Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 网络证据图建设

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 (c), we connect visual anchors to external knowledge through image search, OCR, and text retrieval. Candidate identities are verified against the visual context and retrieved sources, after which source-supported relations and attributes are extracted and iteratively expanded. These results form an input-level evidence graph 𝒢 X \mathcal{G}_{X} that preserves the correspondence among visual anchors, real-world entities, external facts, and supporting sources. See Appendix A.3 for details.
blocks.zh: 如图1(c)所示,我们通过图像搜索、OCR和文本检索将视觉主锚与外部知识相连接。 候选人身份根据视觉上下文和检索来源进行核查,然后提取来源支持的关系和属性并反复扩展。 这些结果形成了输入级证据图G X \ mathcal{G}_{X}},保存了视觉主播,现实世界实体,外部事实,以及支持来源之间的对应. 详情见附录A.3。

blocks.zh: 3.4 基于VGEG的任务构建

blocks.en: Finally, as shown in Figure 1 (e), we synthesize expert trajectories for the verified tasks. An expert model receives only the visual input, question, and available tools and interacts with the environment until producing a final answer or reaching the interaction budget. We retain trajectories that pass both answer-correctness and process-quality evaluation and combine them with single-image trajectories in a unified multi-turn format to construct OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K . See Appendix A.5 for details. For RL, we construct OneSearch-VL-RL-10K from task pools spanning the same three visual input types, with construction details provided in Appendix D .

blocks.en: 4 Onesearch-Bench
blocks.zh: 4 独搜索-奔驰

blocks.en: Existing multimodal search and video deep-research benchmarks primarily report aggregate answer accuracy, often with additional breakdowns by visual content or data source ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . These summaries measure overall performance but do not isolate failures in entity lookup, relation tracing, conditional filtering, or fact composition. We therefore construct OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench and organize their examples by the principal research operation required to answer each question. Both benchmarks use the same operation taxonomy, enabling a consistent analysis across multi-image and video inputs.
blocks.zh: 现有的多模式搜索和视频深度研究基准主要报告总答的准确性,经常还会有按视觉内容或数据来源的额外分解(刘等,2026;高等,2026.). 这些摘要衡量整体性能,但并不孤立实体查询、关系追踪、有条件过滤或事实构成方面的失败。 因此,我们构建了OneSearch-MI-Bench和OneSearch-Video-Bench,并通过回答每个问题所需的主要研究行动来组织它们的例子. 这两项基准都采用相同的业务分类法,从而能够对多图像和视频投入进行一致分析。

blocks.en: Figure 2 presents representative examples and their reference VGEGs, while Appendix Table 6 defines the six principal research operations and reports their distributions across the two benchmarks. Together, they support operation-level analysis of evidence retrieval and composition.
blocks.zh: 图2列出了代表性实例及其参考的VGEGs,而附录表6界定了六项主要研究业务,并报告了这些业务在两项基准中的分布情况。 它们共同支持对证据检索和组成进行业务层面的分析。

blocks.en: For OneSearch-MI-Bench, deduplicated evidence frames from the same visual source form an unordered image set X = { I 1 , … , I K } X=\{I_{1},\ldots,I_{K}\} . Each example depends on at least two images and retains image indices that bind visual anchors to their sources. We remove references to video playback, frame numbers, and unnecessary temporal order so that each question is self-contained over the image set, while preserving the relations needed for fact composition.
blocks.zh: 对于"OneSearch-MI-Bench",从同一种视觉源头复制出的证据帧组成了无序图像集X={一一,.,I K}{一一},\ldots,I_{K}. 每个例子都取决于至少两个图像,并保留将可视锚与源相接的图像指数. 我们删除对视频播放的引用、帧数字和不必要的时间顺序,以使每个问题在图像集上自成一体,同时保留事实构成所需的关系。

blocks.en: For OneSearch-Video-Bench, we preserve temporal structure and link visual anchors to their events, key frames, and web facts. Questions locate clues through visible objects, events, or temporal descriptions, requiring the agent to find relevant video content before retrieving and composing external knowledge. The two branches share candidate sources, VGEG representations, the operation taxonomy, and quality criteria, while producing separate multi-image and video sets.
blocks.zh: 对OneSearch-Video-Bench来说,我们保留了时间结构,并将视觉主播与他们的事件,关键框架和网络事实联系起来. 问题通过可见的物体,事件,或时间描述来定位线索,要求代理商在检索和编译外部知识之前先找到相关的视频内容. 两个分支共享候选来源,VGEG代表,业务分类学,以及质量标准,同时制作单独的多相相机和相机.

blocks.en: Candidates pass checks for information masking, referential uniqueness, visual relevance, and non-triviality. A text-only probe further removes questions that can be answered confidently without the visual input. We then jointly inspect the question, reference answer, and supporting facts for clarity, answer uniqueness, factual correctness, and visual grounding, followed by a strict review of the visual input.
blocks.zh: 候选人通过检查,以进行信息遮掩、偏好独特性、视觉相关性和非三角性。 仅以文字为主的探针会进一步去除在没有视觉输入的情况下可以自信地回答的问题. 然后,我们联合检查问题,参考答案,以及支持事实的清晰度,回答独特性,事实正确性,以及视觉地基,然后严格审查视觉输入.

blocks.en: Terminal correctness does not directly measure whether a rollout obtains and uses the evidence required by the question. We therefore introduce the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR). As illustrated in Figure 3 , EVGR aligns each executed trajectory with an item-specific structured rubric derived from the data engine. The rubric records the answer core, required claim facts, supporting sources and snippets, and applicable frame or region annotations. Two separate judge calls evaluate complementary dimensions. Evidence Traceability ( r trace r_{\mathrm{trace}} ) measures whether tool observations establish the answer-core entities and required fact hops, and whether the reasoning follows those observations without unsupported substitutions. Visual Grounding ( r ground r_{\mathrm{ground}} ) measures whether the correct visible entities, regions, or video frames are identified and used to drive subsequent evidence retrieval. For single- and multi-image inputs, the source images are already visible to the agent policy and no additional visual tool call is required; for video, the selected frames should cover the relevant moments and provide the visual identity used by later searches. The two dimensions are combined into the trajectory-level process reward R EVGR R_{\mathrm{EVGR}} . Their scoring and combination coefficients are specified in the experimental setup.
blocks.zh: 终端正确性并不直接衡量推出是否获得和使用问题所要求的证据。 因此,我们引入了具有证据意识的视觉-圆形Rubric奖赏。 如图3所显示,EVGR将每个已执行的轨迹与数据引擎产生的特定项目的结构化标题相统一。 标题记录了答案核心、所要求的索赔事实、佐证来源和片段以及适用的框架或区域说明。 两个独立的法官要求评价互补层面。 证据可追踪性(r trace r_{\mathrm{trace}})衡量工具观察是否建立解答核心实体并需要事实跳出,推理是否遵循这些观察而不支持替代. Visual Grounding (r ground r_{\mathrm{ground}}) 衡量是否识别出正确的可见实体,区域,或视频帧并用于驱动后续的证据检索. 对于单相和多相相输入,源图像已经可见于代理政策,不需要额外的可视化工具呼叫;对于视频,所选帧应覆盖相关时刻并提供后期搜索所使用的可视化身份. 这两个维度结合到轨迹级进程奖励R EVGR _{\mathrm{EVGR}}. 它们的得分和组合系数在实验设置中有所规定.

blocks.en: Following OpenSearch-VL ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , we adopt its answer-correctness reward R acc R_{\mathrm{acc}} and query-quality reward R query R_{\mathrm{query}} , and augment them with our EVGR process reward. The resulting reward is gated by format validity: R ⁡ ( τ ) = R fmt ​ ( τ ) ​ ( λ acc ​ R acc ​ ( τ ) + λ query ​ R query ​ ( τ ) + λ EVGR ​ R EVGR ​ ( τ ) ) . R(\tau)=R_{\mathrm{fmt}}(\tau)\Bigl(\lambda_{\mathrm{acc}}R_{\mathrm{acc}}(\tau)+\lambda_{\mathrm{query}}R_{\mathrm{query}}(\tau)+\lambda_{\mathrm{EVGR}}R_{\mathrm{EVGR}}(\tau)\Bigr). (7) Here, R acc R_{\mathrm{acc}} evaluates the final answer, R query R_{\mathrm{query}} evaluates the relevance and progression of search queries, and R fmt R_{\mathrm{fmt}} enforces a valid reasoning, tool-call, and response structure. The reward coefficients and implementation details are provided in Appendix D .

We optimize the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), normalizing rewards across trajectories sampled for the same question and applying the clipped objective only to policy-generated tokens. Tool observations remain conditioning context and are excluded from the policy loss. For trajectories terminated by tool-execution failures, we follow the fatal-aware mechanism of OpenSearch-VL ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and retain only the valid pre-failure prefix for optimization.

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: OneSearch-VL is initialized from Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and trained in two stages. Supervised fine-tuning uses OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K . Reinforcement learning starts from the joint SFT model and uses OneSearch-VL-RL-10K . Both datasets cover all three visual input types. All online rollouts use the same tool environment.
blocks.zh: OneSearch-VL由Qune3-VL-8B(Bai等,2025年)初始化并分两个阶段培训. 监督微调使用OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K. 强化学习从联合SFT模式开始,并使用OneSearch-VL-RL-10K. 两个数据集都涵盖了所有三种视觉输入类型. 所有在线推出都使用同样的工具环境。

blocks.en: For single-image evaluation, we follow OpenSearch-VL ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and use seven knowledge-intensive benchmarks: SimpleVQA ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , VDR ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) , MMSearch ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , LiveVQA ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2025b ) , FVQA ( Wang et al., 2017 ) , and InfoSeek ( Chen et al., 2023 ) . For multi-image and video evaluation, we use our OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench, together with VideoDR ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . On the two OneSearch benchmarks, we additionally report performance by the six principal research operations defined in Section 4 . Following OpenSearch-VL, we use GPT-4o ( OpenAI Team, 2024 ) to compare each final response with the reference answer and return a binary correctness decision.
blocks.zh: 对于单相图评价,我们遵循OpenSearch-VL(Chen等,2026年),并使用7个知识密集型基准:SimpleVQA(Cheng等,2025年),VDR(Zeng等,2026年),MMSearch. (Jiang等,2025.),LiveVQA (Fu等,2025.),瀏覽comp-VL (Geng等,2025b.),FVQA (Wang等,2017.),和Infoseek (Chen等,2023.). 对于多图像和视频评价,我们使用我们的"OneSearch-MI-Bench"和"OneSearch-Video-Bench",以及"VideoDR"(刘等,2026年). 在 " 一个搜索 " 基准方面,我们还报告了第4节界定的六项主要研究行动的业绩。 在OpenSearch-VL之后,我们使用GPT-4o(OpenAI Team,2024)将每个最终响应与参考答案进行比较,并返回一个二进制正确性决定.

blocks.en: Expert trajectory synthesis, online RL rollouts, and inference share the same dispatcher and tool interfaces. All training variants are compared under the same tool environment and evaluation protocol. Full optimization, rollout, reward, and inference configurations are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 专家轨迹合成,在线RL推出,推论共享相同的调度器和工具接口. 所有培训变体都在同一工具环境和评价协议下进行比较。 附录中提供了全面优化、推出、奖励和推断配置。

blocks.en: 6.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 6.2 主要结果

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes the results on seven single-image deep-research benchmarks. OneSearch-VL-8B obtains an average score of 58.3, outperforming the same-scale Qwen3-VL-8B Agent by 16.3 points and OpenSearch-VL-8B by 1.7 points. It improves over OpenSearch-VL on all seven benchmarks, with gains of 2.8, 2.1, and 2.0 points on VDR, InfoSeek, and MMSearch, respectively. It also achieves the best result among the listed agentic methods on six of the seven benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表2总结了7个单一图像深度研究基准的结果。 OneSearch-VL-8B平均得分58.3分,以16.3分比同级的Qune3-VL-8B Agent成绩高,以1.7分比OpenSearch-VL-8B成绩好. 它改进了OpenSearch-VL所有7个基准,在VDR,InfoSeek和MMSearch上分别获得2.8分,2.1分和2.0分. 它还在所列的7个基准中的6个基准方法中取得了最佳结果。

blocks.en: The gains span benchmarks emphasizing visual entity identification, open-web retrieval, and multi-step knowledge reasoning. Together with the data-mixture ablation below, these results show that joint training with multi-image and video trajectories does not trade off image research performance.
blocks.zh: 收益跨越强调视觉实体识别、开放网络检索和多步骤知识推理的基准。 这些结果与下面的数据-混合衰减一起表明,与多相像和视频轨迹的联合培训不取舍于图像研究的表现.

blocks.zh: 表2:关于单相深度研究基准的结果。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , OneSearch-VL-8B improves over Qwen3-VL-8B by 20.2 points on OneSearch-MI-Bench, 17.6 points on OneSearch-Video-Bench, and 27.0 points on VideoDR. It improves all six research operations on both OneSearch benchmarks, showing that the gains extend beyond simple fact lookup to questions that combine evidence across images or video frames.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,OneSearch-VL-8B比Qune3-VL-8B在OneSearch-MI-Bench上提高了20.2分,在OneSearch-Video-Bench上提高了17.6分,在VideoDR上提高了27.0分. 它改进了OneSearch两个基准的所有6个研究操作,表明这些收益超越了简单的事实调查,而到了将各种图像或视频框架的证据结合起来的问题。

blocks.en: The operation-level breakdown further identifies where the gains arise. On multi-image tasks, knowledge-conditioned counting, multi-anchor arithmetic, and multi-anchor comparison improve by 29.8, 26.3, and 22.5 points, respectively. blocks.en: Table 4 (a) compares SFT mixtures composed of single-image (I), multi-image (M), and video (V) trajectories using the same number of training iterations. blocks.en: 7 Related Work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: 7.1 Multimodal Search and Deep Research
blocks.zh: 7.1 多式联运搜索和深入研究

blocks.en: Active search enables language models to supplement parametric knowledge with external evidence acquired through multi-turn interaction ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . Multimodal research extends this paradigm to visual inputs by combining image and text retrieval with visual inspection, and training search policies through synthetic tool-use trajectories and reinforcement learning ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Narayan et al., 2025 ) . Related work explores active visual perception, generalizable tool use, and joint optimization of reasoning and search, advancing research agents that integrate visual understanding with external evidence acquisition ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Chng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 主动搜索使语言模型能够用通过多回合互动获得的外部证据来补充参数化知识(Jin等,2025年). 多式联运研究通过将图像和文本检索与视觉检查相结合,将这一范式扩展到视觉输入,并通过合成工具使用轨迹和强化学习,制定培训搜索政策(Wu等,2025;Geng等,2025a; 黄等,2026;陈等,2026;姚等,2026;纳良等,2025. 相关工作探索活性视觉感知,可通俗工具使用,并联合优化推理与搜索,推进将视觉理解与外部证据获取相结合的研究代理(刘等,2025;洪等,2025;Chng等,2025.).

blocks.en: 7.2 Video Deep Research
blocks.zh: 7.2 视频 深入研究

blocks.en: Video deep research additionally requires agents to locate relevant moments, identify objects across frames, and connect them to external knowledge. VideoDR formalizes this setting through an open-web benchmark ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Recent methods develop video-oriented research pipelines by jointly training temporal localization, spatial inspection, and multimodal retrieval ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , or by staging tool use to guide visual grounding before web exploration ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . These studies highlight temporal and spatial grounding as essential links between video content and external evidence.
blocks.zh: 视频深度研究还需要代理商查找相关瞬间,识别跨帧的物体,并将其与外部知识相接. 视频 DR通过一个开放式网络基准(Liu等人,2026年)使这一设置正式化。 最近的方法通过联合培训时间定位、空间检查和多模式检索(Gao等,2026年),或通过在网络勘探前使用工具引导可视定位(Fang等,2026年)。 这些研究强调,时间和空间定位是视频内容与外部证据之间必不可少的联系。

blocks.en: 7.3 Unified Visual Reasoning
blocks.zh: 7.3 统一视觉理由

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning has improved image question answering and detection ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ) , image segmentation ( You and Wu, 2025 ) , video question answering ( Feng et al., 2025a ) , and temporal or spatio-temporal video understanding ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ) , with many methods designed for specific tasks. LLaVA-ST jointly addresses fine-grained spatial, temporal, and spatio-temporal understanding ( Li et al., 2025a ) . OneThinker jointly learns question answering, captioning, grounding, tracking, and segmentation across images and videos, demonstrating the potential of training across tasks and visual inputs ( Feng et al., 2025b ) . Our work focuses on unification at the level of deep research: a single policy combines input-specific visual operations with external retrieval and fact composition across single images, image collections, and videos.
blocks.zh: 强化学习改善了图像问题回答和检测(黄等,2025;沈等,2025.),图像分解(你和吴等,2025.),视频问题回答(冯等,2025a.),以及时空或时空视频理解(王等,2025.;李等,2025.b.),多种方法为具体任务所设计. LLaVA-ST联合处理精细的空间、时间和时空理解(Li等,2025a.)。 OneThinker联合学习问答、字幕、地面定位、跟踪和跨图像和视频的分解,展示培训跨任务和视觉投入的潜力(Feng等,2025b)。 我们的工作重点是在深入研究层面的统一:一项单一的政策将输入特定视觉操作与外部检索和单个图像、图像收藏和视频中的事实构成结合起来。

blocks.en: 7.4 Structural References and Process Supervision
blocks.zh: 7.4 结构参考资料和过程监督

blocks.en: Beyond answer correctness, research agents receive supervision through query-quality and tool-use rewards ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . Other approaches use intermediate entity anchors and citation-supported factual requirements as references for credit assignment ( Jiao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , while process-oriented objectives evaluate search decisions or complete rollouts ( Yan et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . These studies establish the value of structured evidence for agent supervision. We use VGEG to preserve visual provenance and answer-composition dependencies in a shared task-level reference, connecting task construction and verification with trajectory supervision. EVGR derives evidence-traceability and visual-grounding criteria from this reference to evaluate complete research trajectories.
blocks.zh: 除了回答正确性外,研究人员通过查询质量和工具使用奖励获得监督(Chen等,2026;Gao等,2026)。 其他方法使用中间实体锚地和引用支持的事实要求作为信用分配的参考(Jiao等,2026;Zhang等,2026;而以过程为导向的目标评价搜索决定或完全推出(Yan等,2026;Wang等,2026). 这些研究确定了结构化证据对代理人监督的价值。 我们利用VGEG在共享的任务级别参考中保存视觉出处和答案组合依赖性,将任务构建和核查与轨迹监督联系起来. EVGR从这一参考中得出了证据可追踪性和可视性标准,用以评价完整的研究轨迹.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduced OneSearch-VL, a unified agent for deep research over single-image, multi-image, and videos. VGEG links visual anchors, source-supported facts, and answer-producing operations, enabling verified task construction, expert-trajectory filtering, and process-level reward design. Building on this structure, EVGR evaluates both evidence traceability and visual grounding. Across seven established single-image benchmarks and two operation-oriented benchmarks, OneSearch-VL consistently improves over the evaluated open-source baselines; the ablations further demonstrate complementary supervision across visual input types and the benefit of EVGR.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了OneSearch-VL, 用于对单相图像、多相图像和视频进行深入研究的统一代理。 VGEG将可视化主锚,源支持的事实,以及解答生成操作相链接,使经核实的任务构建,专家-导出过滤,以及过程级奖励设计成为可能. 在这个结构的基础上,EVGR既评价证据的可追溯性,也评价可视地面. 在7个既定的单一图像基准和2个面向行动的基准中,OneSearch-VL在评价的开源基线上不断改进;模拟进一步显示对各种视觉输入的辅助监督以及EVGR的好处。

blocks.en: 9 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 9 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: OneSearch-VL depends on external search tools such as TextSearch and ImageSearch (Table 1 ) and changing webpages, which can affect evidence availability and exact reproducibility. Future work should preserve retrieval snapshots and evaluate robustness to tool failures. Automated VGEG construction and model-based rewards may also introduce annotation errors or judging biases. Human calibration and open multimodal process judges could improve the reliability of trajectory-level assessment. Multi-turn interaction incurs additional inference and tool costs, motivating adaptive budgets and cost-aware training.
blocks.zh: OneSearch-VL依赖于外部搜索工具,如TextSearch和ImageSearch(表1)和正在变化的网页,这可以影响证据的提供和准确的再生产. 今后的工作应当保存检索快照,并评估工具故障的强度。 自动 VGEG 构建和基于模型的奖励也可能引入注释错误或判断偏差. 人类校准和开放式多式程序法官可以提高轨迹评估的可靠性。 多轮互动需要额外的推论和工具成本,激发适应性预算和成本意识培训。

blocks.en: Object grouping and representative-view selection use deterministic matching. Objects with matching types and similar entity or name cues are grouped across frames; the largest available bounding box is selected as the representative view, with alternate views retained from other frames. Crops with a short side below 256 pixels are enlarged to 256 pixels. We use GPT-4.1 ( OpenAI, 2025a ) to route each object to reverse image search, OCR followed by text search, or omission based on its crop, name, type, candidate entity cues, and event relation. For the OCR route, we also use the model to read visible text and propose a candidate entity; the image-search route uses an external reverse-image-search service to retrieve candidate entities and webpages.
blocks.zh: 对象分组和代表性视图选择使用确定匹配. 具有匹配类型和类似实体或名称提示的对象被组合到不同框架之间;选择最大的可用边框作为代表性视图,保留其他框架的替代视图。 短边小于256像素的作物被扩大为256像素. 我们使用GPT-4.1(OpenAI, 2025a) 来引导每个对象反向图像搜索, OCR 之后是文本搜索, 或者根据它的收件, 名称, 类型, 候选实体提示以及事件关系忽略 。 对于OCR路由,我们也使用模型来读取可见文本并提议一个候选实体;图像搜索路由使用外部反向图像搜索服务来取回候选实体和网页.

blocks.en: Because reverse image search is sensitive to viewpoint and cropping, we construct a retrieval pool for each object grouped across frames, containing its representative crop and alternate views from other sampled frames. If one crop yields no usable candidates, we retry the search with another view from the same object pool. We first use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to select visually grounded anchors with research potential from the event context and initial retrieval results. We then use the model to combine the object crop, local visual description, and image-search or OCR evidence to propose an entity identity, assess whether the retrieved entity matches the visual object, and formulate entity-specific text queries. We use Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to read the retrieved pages, produce query-focused summaries, and verify consistency between the page evidence and the candidate identity; search snippets are used when the page body is unavailable. Duplicate pages and explicitly mismatched identities are removed. The remaining identities, source objects, and webpage evidence form the candidate entity pool.
blocks.zh: 由于反向图像搜索对视角和裁剪十分敏感,我们为跨帧组合的每个对象构建一个检索池,包含其代表性的切入和从其他被采样的帧取出的其他视图. 如果一种作物没有产生有用的候选物,我们用同一物体库的另一种视图重新进行搜索。 我们首先使用"种子2.0 Pro"(ByteDance Seed, 2026)从事件背景和初始检索结果中选择具有研究潜力的可视锚. 然后我们利用模型结合对象裁剪,局部视觉描述,以及图像搜索或OCR证据,提出实体身份,评估被取回的实体是否与视觉对象相匹配,并拟订实体特定文本查询. 我们使用Qwen3-32B(Yang等,2025年)来读取取的页面,制作以查询为重点的摘要,并验证页面证据与候选身份的一致性;在页面正文无法使用时使用搜索片段. 复制页和明显不匹配的身份被删除. 其余的身份、源对象和网页证据构成候选实体库。

blocks.en: We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to extract source-supported relations from the verified page summaries. Each fact records its head entity, relation, tail entity or attribute value, supporting URL, and evidence quotation: f = ( u , r , z , p , ξ ) . f=(u,r,z,p,\xi). (9) Here, p p is the source URL and ξ \xi is the retained supporting text. A deterministic parser checks required fields and matches normalized quotations against the supplied source material; a matched quotation must contain at least six normalized characters. Numeric facts can additionally retain units and value types. For entity-valued tails, we use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to decide whether to continue based on entity specificity, relation confidence, task relevance, and evidence-expansion potential and to propose a follow-up query; we then use Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to summarize and verify the retrieved expansion pages. For each expandable entity, the pipeline retains one query, retrieves five results, deduplicates pages by host, and reads the selected pages. Each parent selects high-confidence successors with scores of at least 0.5, and expansion stops when no suitable successor remains.

blocks.en: Graph assembly uses no additional model and deterministically merges the preceding outputs. The graph contains events, frames, localized objects, entities, attributes, and source pages. Structural edges associate events with frames and frames with objects; grounding edges bind objects to candidate entities; factual edges connect entities to other entities or attributes while retaining source evidence. Entity and relation normalization merges compatible records, removes duplicate edges, and removes self-loops. The resulting input-level graph 𝒢 X \mathcal{G}_{X} supplies a common evidence context for multiple candidate questions.
blocks.zh: 图组装不使用其他模型,确定合并前述产出。 该图包含事件,框架,本地化对象,实体,属性,以及源页面. 结构边缘将事件与有对象的帧和帧联系起来;将对象绑定在候选实体上;事实边缘将实体与其他实体或属性联系起来,同时保留源证据. 实体和关系正常化合并了相容的记录,去掉了重复的边缘,并去掉了自来Loops. 由此得到的输入级图G X\ mathcal{G}为多个候选问题提供了共同的证据背景.

blocks.en: A.4 Stage 4: VGEG-Based Task Construction
blocks.zh: A.4 第4阶段:基于VGEG的任务建设

blocks.en: Figure 1 (d) contains four blocks: LLM-Guided QA Generation, QA Verifier, Visual Entity Fuzzing Rewrite, and Quality Filter. VGEG is retained as the task-level reference throughout these blocks.
blocks.zh: 图1 (d)包含四个块:LLM-Guided QA生成,QA验证器,视觉实体模糊重写,以及质量过滤. 在整个这些区块中,VGEG被保留作为任务级参考.

blocks.en: We organize clip and event descriptions from the dense video caption tree, visual-anchor records, source-supported facts from the input-level graph 𝒢 X \mathcal{G}_{X} , and candidate relation chains into a generation context. We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to propose candidate questions spanning the six research operations. The model uses visual descriptions and anchor mappings rather than raw video frames and outputs a question, answer, supporting facts, operation type, visual references, and corresponding frame indices. Multi-anchor questions retain a separate visual description and frame mapping for each referenced object. Relation chains can occur within each branch before the branch results are joined, counted, compared, or used in arithmetic.
blocks.zh: 我们从稠密的视频字幕树上组织剪辑和事件描述,视觉-锁定记录,来自输入级图G X\ mathcal{G}_{X}}的源支持事实,以及候选关系链入代为上下文. 我们使用"种子2.0 Pro"(ByteDance Seed, 2026)来提出贯穿六起研究业务的候选问题. 该模型使用可视化描述和锚地映射,而不是原始视频帧并输出出一个问答,支持事实,操作类型,可视化参考,以及相应的帧指数. 多指针问题保留了单独的可视化描述和每个被引用对象的框架映射. 关系链可以在每个分支内部发生,然后将分支结果相加,计算,比较,或用于算术.

blocks.en: The same step assembles the task-level VGEG using the main-text definition Γ i = Φ i ​ ( 𝒢 X ) = ( 𝒜 i , ℱ i , 𝒪 i , ℛ i ) \Gamma_{i}=\Phi_{i}(\mathcal{G}_{X})=(\mathcal{A}_{i},\mathcal{F}_{i},\mathcal{O}_{i},\mathcal{R}_{i}) . The projection selects 𝒜 i \mathcal{A}_{i} from the visual anchors and grounded entities in 𝒢 X \mathcal{G}_{X} , retaining their image, frame, or region locations. It selects ℱ i \mathcal{F}_{i} from the graph relations and attributes that provide source support for the task. The operation set 𝒪 i \mathcal{O}_{i} describes the answer-producing retrieval or composition, while ℛ i \mathcal{R}_{i} retains the selected grounding and support edges and adds task-specific dependencies connecting anchors, entities, facts, and operations. These components are assembled deterministically from the visual-reference fields, selected used_facts , task-structure labels, source records, and their grounding and dependency links, without an additional model call.

blocks.en: The verifier first checks the evidence path and task structure against the candidate graph using deterministic rules without an additional model call. Relation-chain questions are checked for continuity between successive facts. Multi-anchor questions require distinct referenced objects and corresponding supporting facts. Comparisons use a common semantic attribute; arithmetic uses numeric operands with compatible meanings; knowledge-conditioned counting associates counted entities with facts supporting the condition. Frame references are checked against the available entity-to-frame mappings, and the facts required to derive the answer must be supported by the candidate graph.
blocks.zh: 核查员首先使用确定性规则,在没有额外模型调用的情况下,对照候选图表检查证据路径和任务结构. 对关系链问题进行核对,以确定连续事实之间的连续性。 多指针问题需要不同的被引用对象和相应的佐证事实. 比较使用通用的语义属性;算术使用具有相容含义的数值操作;以知识为条件的计数关联计算有事实支持条件的实体. 参照现有实体对框架的绘图,对框架参考进行核对,获得答案所需的事实必须附有候选图表。

blocks.en: For a candidate ( q i , y i , Γ i ) (q_{i},y_{i},\Gamma_{i}) , the QA Verifier then gathers graph relations, source quotations, page summaries, and visual descriptions associated with its supporting entities. We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to re-answer the question using only this evidence and to check semantic agreement between the regenerated and proposed answers, allowing aliases and equivalent units or date formats. To prevent answer leakage, explicit occurrences of the candidate answer in the fact summary are masked when possible. This stage checks that the supplied evidence supports recovery of the answer.
blocks.zh: 对于一个候选人(qi, yi, Γ Γi) (q_{i}, y_{i},\Gamma_{i}), QA验证员然后收集图表关系, 出处引用, 页面摘要, 以及与其支持实体相关的视觉描述. 我们使用"种子2.0 Pro"(ByteDance Seed, 2026)只使用这些证据重新回答问题,并检查再生成和拟议答案之间的语义一致,允许别名和等同单位或日期格式. 为了防止答案漏出,尽可能掩盖事实摘要中明显出现的候选人答案。 这一阶段检查所提供的证据是否有助于收回答复。

blocks.en: We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to inspect the referenced key frames and rewrite explicit entity names into descriptions that locate the intended objects. Multi-hop questions also conceal intermediate entity names so that the final question starts from visible targets without exposing entities along the retrieval path.
blocks.zh: 我们使用"种子2.0 Pro"(ByteDance Seed,2026)来检查被引用的密钥框架并重写出明确的实体名称来进行描述以定位预定对象. 多跳问题也隐藏了中间实体名称,这样最后的问题就会从可见的目标开始,而不会暴露在检索路径上的实体.

blocks.en: The same step instantiates the task for its target visual input type. For a multi-image task, we extract the deduplicated key frames referenced by its VGEG, organize them as an unordered image collection, and remap frame- and region-level references to image indices. References to video playback, timestamps, and unnecessary temporal order are removed so that the question is self-contained over the image collection. For a video task, we retain the original video and its event, timestamp, key-frame, and region bindings, preserving the need for temporal localization.
blocks.zh: 同一步骤将任务作为目标视觉输入类型即时化. 对于一个多图像任务,我们提取其VGEG所引用的被破解的密钥帧,将它们组织为无序图像集,并重新绘制图像帧和地区级的参考. 提及视频回放,时间戳和不必要的时序被去掉,使问题在图像收藏上自成一体. 对于视频任务,我们保留了原始视频及其事件,时间戳,键框,以及区域绑定,保留了时间本地化的需要.

blocks.en: We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to assess information masking, referential uniqueness, visual relevance, and whether external retrieval is required. A question-only probe rejects a candidate when the model can reliably recover the reference answer without the visual input. The retained record contains the visual input, final question, answer, VGEG annotations, operation label, and visual-reference mappings.
blocks.zh: 我们使用"种子2.0 Pro"(ByteDance Seed,2026)来评估信息遮掩,偏好独有,视觉相关性,以及是否需要外部检索. 在模型可以可靠地恢复参考答案而无需视觉输入时,仅以提问为主的探测器会拒绝一个候选. 所保留的记录包含视觉输入,最后问答,VGEG说明,操作标签,和可视参考映射.

blocks.en: A.5 Stage 5: Expert Trajectory Synthesis
blocks.zh: A.5 第5阶段:专家轨迹综合

blocks.en: Figure 1 (e) contains two steps: multi-turn trajectory synthesis and rejection sampling.
blocks.zh: 图1(e)包含两个步骤:多回合轨迹合成和拒绝取样。

blocks.en: We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) as the expert model to solve each verified task in the real tool environment. The expert receives the visual input, question, and tool definitions, while the reference answer is withheld for subsequent evaluation. At each turn, the model produces reasoning followed by a tool call or a final response. The environment executes the tool and appends its observation, including returned visual resources, to the interaction history, producing an interleaved reasoning–action–observation trajectory.
blocks.zh: 我们使用"种子2.0 Pro"(ByteDance Speed,2026)作为专家模型,在真实的工具环境中解决每一个被核实的任务. 专家接受视觉输入、提问和工具定义,而参考答复则被扣作后续评价。 每次转弯时,模型都会产生推理,然后是工具呼叫或最后回应. 环境执行工具,并将它的观察,包括返回的视觉资源,附加到交互历史中,产生一个交互推理-动作-观察轨迹.

blocks.en: We use GPT-4o ( OpenAI Team, 2024 ) to compare the final response of each raw expert rollout with the reference answer while allowing semantically equivalent formulations. Rollouts with an incorrect answer or without a valid terminal response are rejected.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-4o(OpenAI Team,2024年)来比较每个原始专家推出的最终响应与参考答案,同时允许同构等效配方. 有错误答案或有效终端响应的推出被拒绝。

blocks.en: The remaining rollouts undergo process-level evaluation, which checks that each trajectory contains at least one effective tool call, remains logically consistent with tool observations, and avoids ineffective repetition. We retain only trajectories that pass both judges as high-quality expert demonstrations for SFT.
blocks.zh: 其余的推出工作经过流程级评价,该评价检查每个轨道至少包含一个有效的工具呼叫,逻辑上与工具观测保持一致,并避免无效的重复. 我们只保留了通过两个评委的轨迹,作为SFT的高质量专家示范.

blocks.en: Appendix B Benchmark Construction and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录B 基准建设和评价

blocks.en: This appendix details the construction protocols for OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench, including visual-input construction, VGEG-based operation assignment, difficulty and visual-domain annotation, and human review.
blocks.zh: 本附录详述了OneSearch-MI-Bench和OneSearch-Video-Bench的构建协议,包括可视输入构建,基于VGEG的运行任务,难度和可视域注释,以及人文审查.

blocks.en: B.1 Visual Input Construction
blocks.zh: B.1 视觉输入建筑

blocks.en: For OneSearch-MI-Bench, deduplicated evidence frames from the same source video form an unordered image collection. Questions are rewritten to refer to the images and visible objects, while image indices preserve the bindings to their visual anchors. References to video playback, frame numbers, and unnecessary temporal order are removed. Each retained item requires evidence from at least two images, preventing reduction to a single-image question.
blocks.zh: 对于"OneSearch-MI-Bench",从同源视频复制出的证据帧构成无序图像集. 问题被重写来指代图像和可见对象,而图像指数则保留了对其视觉锚地的束缚. 视频回放的参考文献,帧数和不必要的时序被删除. 每件保留的物品都需要至少两幅图像提供证据,防止缩小成单一图像问题。

blocks.en: For OneSearch-Video-Bench, we preserve the temporal structure of the source video and bind each visual anchor to its corresponding event and key frames. Questions refer to relevant content through visible objects, events, or temporal descriptions, requiring the model to localize visual evidence before retrieving and composing external facts.
blocks.zh: 对于"OneSearch-Video-Bench",我们保留了源视频的时间结构,并将每个视觉主播绑定在相应的事件和关键帧上. 问题是指通过可见对象,事件,或时间描述的相关内容,要求模型在检索和编译外在事实之前将视觉证据本地化.

blocks.en: B.2 Research Operations and Reference Structures
blocks.zh: B.2 研究业务和参考结构

blocks.en: Each benchmark item stores ( X i , q i , y i , Γ i , s i ) (X_{i},q_{i},y_{i},\Gamma_{i},s_{i}) , where s i s_{i} is determined by the final answer-producing operation in its task-level VGEG rather than by visual content or source category. Figure 2 (a)–(f) shows representative examples of the six operations, and Table 6 provides their definitions and distributions.
blocks.zh: 每个基准项存储(Xi, qi, y i, Γ, Γ, Γ) (X_{i}, q_{i}, y_{i},\Gamma_{i}, s_{i}), 其中 s i s_{i} 由其任务级VGEG中的最终出答案操作决定,而不是由可视内容或源类别决定. 图2(a)-(f)显示了六项业务的代表性实例,表6提供了其定义和分布情况。

blocks.en: When evidence branches contain intermediate relation chains, the category follows the operation that combines the branch results into the answer. For example, two anchors may each initiate multi-hop retrieval, but a question is labeled as multi-anchor comparison when its final answer compares the retrieved attributes. This rule assigns one principal operation to each item while preserving all intermediate dependencies in its VGEG.
blocks.zh: 当证据分支包含中间关系链时,类别遵循将分支结果结合到答案的操作. 例如,两个锚可能每个启动多跳检索,但当一个问题的最后答案比较取回的属性时,被贴上多跳检索的标签. 本规则为每个项目指定一个主操作,同时在其VGEG中保留所有中间依赖.

blocks.en: The two benchmarks contain 608 questions. The five compositional categories beyond single-anchor lookup account for 555 questions, or 91.3% of the combined set. Multi-image questions contain 2–8 images , with a mean of 3.05 images per question. These statistics show that the benchmarks primarily test relation tracing, conditional filtering, and cross-anchor fact composition.
blocks.zh: 这两个基准包含608个问题。 单指查取以外的5个组成类别占了555个问题,占组合的91.3%. 多图像问题包含2–8个图像,每个问题的平均图像为3.05. 这些统计数据表明,这些基准主要测试关系追踪、有条件的过滤和交叉锁定的事实构成。

blocks.en: Within each benchmark, examples are ranked by this score and partitioned into easy, medium, and hard groups. Both branches yield empirical boundary scores of 14.4 and 22.2; ties at a boundary are deterministically assigned across adjacent groups to keep their sizes balanced. The three groups contain 100, 100, and 101 multi-image questions and 102, 102, and 103 video questions, respectively. Figure 4 (a) shows the full score distributions and their partition boundaries. These labels represent relative evidence complexity within each visual input type rather than independently calibrated human difficulty.

blocks.en: B.4 Human Review and Annotation
blocks.zh: B.4 人文审查和注释

blocks.en: Candidates first pass the automatic information-masking, referential-uniqueness, visual-relevance, and non-triviality checks described in Appendix A.4 . These checks prevent answer or intermediate-entity leakage, ensure that each visual reference identifies its intended object, remove questions that do not require the visual input, and reject questions that can be answered reliably from text alone.
blocks.zh: 候选人首先通过附录A.4所描述的自动信息假冒、偏好独特性、视觉相关性和非三角性检查。 这些检查防止了答案或中间实体的渗出,确保了每个可视参考物能够识别其预定对象,去除不需要可视输入的问题,并拒绝仅从文本中可以可靠地回答的问题.

blocks.en: After automatic filtering, human annotators jointly inspect the visual input, question, reference answer, task-level VGEG, and supporting webpages. They verify that each visual reference identifies the intended object, each required fact is source-supported, the reference answer follows from the VGEG dependencies, and the principal operation matches the final answer-producing step. The reviewed record retains the confirmed visual-anchor bindings, supporting facts, reference answer, and operation annotation.
blocks.zh: 在自动过滤后,人类注释者联合检查了视觉输入,提问,参考答案,任务级别VGEG,以及支持网页. 他们核实每个可视化的参考物识别出预期对象,每个需要的事实都是源支持的,参考解答遵循了VGEG的依赖性,主操作与最终的解答生成步骤相匹配. 经审查的记录保留了经确认的可视-指针捆绑、佐证事实、参考答案和操作注释。

blocks.en: A final quality review further checks question clarity, the presence and distinguishability of the referenced visual objects, and consistency across the annotations. Candidates with ambiguous visual references, unsupported required facts, indeterminate answers, or unclear operation labels are rejected from the final benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 最后的质量审查进一步检查了是否清晰、所引用的视觉物体是否存在和可辨别性以及说明的一致性。 具有模棱两可的视觉参考,不支持所要求的事实,不确定的答案,或不明确的操作标签的候选人从最终基准中被拒绝.

blocks.en: Appendix C Tool Interface and Trajectory Representation
blocks.zh: 附录C 工具接口和轨迹说明

blocks.en: This appendix specifies the execution semantics of the tools in Table 1 , including visual-resource registration, tool inputs and outputs, and the common interaction records used for expert synthesis, reinforcement learning, and inference.
blocks.zh: 本附录具体规定了表1中工具的执行语义,包括可视资源注册,工具输入和输出,以及用于专家合成,强化学习和推论的共同交互记录.

blocks.en: C.1 Resource Registry and Tool Availability
blocks.zh: C.1 资源登记和工具可用性

blocks.en: At the beginning of an episode, the environment registers the visual input in an episode-level resource table. A single image and each member of an image collection receive separate image handles, while a video handle refers to the sampled frame grid visible to the policy. Crops, enhanced images, extracted frames, and selected clips are registered as new image or clip handles and can be reused by later calls. This enables compositions such as selecting a video frame, cropping a local region, and then applying OCR or image search.
blocks.zh: 在一集的开头,环境将视觉输入记录在一个插曲级的资源表中. 单个图像和一个图像收藏的每个成员都接受单独的图像手柄,而视频手柄则指政策可见的被采样的框架网格. 裁剪,增强的图像,取出的框架,和所选的剪辑被注册为新的图像或剪辑手柄并被后期调用所再用. 这使得可以选择视频帧,裁剪局部区域等组成,然后应用OCR或图像搜索.

blocks.en: Single-image and multi-image inputs expose 𝒯 vis ∪ 𝒯 ret \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{vis}}\cup\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{ret}} , while video inputs additionally expose 𝒯 temp \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{temp}} . All three visual input types use the same call protocol: one tool call is executed per interaction turn, and its observation is returned before the next action.
blocks.zh: 单相相相和多相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 所有三种视觉输入类型都使用同一种调用协议:每个交互转盘执行一个工具调用,在下个动作前返回它的观察.

blocks.en: C.2 Tool Execution Semantics
blocks.zh: C.2 工具执行语义

blocks.en: We implement spatial cropping with PIL. Given an image handle and a normalized box ( x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 ) ∈ [ 0 , 1000 ] 4 (x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2})\in[0,1000]^{4} , the executor maps the box to pixel coordinates, extracts the region, and registers it as a new image resource. The tool isolates local visual cues before OCR, enhancement, or image search.
blocks.zh: 我们与PIL一起实施空间收割。 鉴于图像控件和正版的框 (x 1, y 1, x 2, y 2 ) ∈ [0, 1000] 4 (x_{1}, y_{1}, x_{2}, y_{2}]\ 在 [0 1100] ^{4}中,执行器将盒子绘制成像素坐标,取出区域,并将其注册为新的图像资源. 该工具在OCR,增强,或图像搜索之前将本地视觉提示隔离出.

blocks.en: We implement OCR with PaddleOCR. The backend detects text regions, recognizes their contents, and returns the text spans together with bounding boxes and confidence scores as a textual observation. The tool is typically applied to cropped or enhanced signs, documents, logos, and captions.
blocks.zh: 我们和PaddleOCR一起执行OCR. 后端检测出文本区域,识别其内容,并返回文本的跨度与边框和置信分数作为文本观察. 该工具通常用于裁剪或增强的标志、文件、标志和标题。

blocks.en: We implement perspective correction with OpenCV. The executor applies grayscale conversion, Gaussian smoothing, and Canny edge detection, locates a quadrilateral among the external contours, orders its corners, and estimates a four-point perspective transform. The rectified fronto-parallel view is registered as a new image resource.
blocks.zh: 我们用OpenCV执行视角校正. 执行器应用了灰度转换,高斯平滑,和坎尼边缘探测,在外相轮廓中定位出一个四边形,命令它的角,并估计出一个四分视角转换. 校正的前向视图被登记为新图像资源 。

blocks.en: We implement super-resolution with EDSR through the OpenCV dnn_superres interface. The network upsamples the input at the scale supplied by the call and registers the result as a new image resource for subsequent OCR, cropping, or image search.
blocks.zh: 我们通过OpenCV dnn_Superres接口执行与EDSR的超解析. 网络以呼叫提供的规模对输入进行取样,并将结果作为新的图像资源登记,用于随后的OCR、裁剪或图像搜索。

blocks.en: We implement sharpening with OpenCV unsharp masking. Given amount α \alpha , the tool combines the input with its Gaussian-blurred version as I out = ( 1 + α ) ​ I − α ⁡ ( G σ ∗ I ) I_{\mathrm{out}}=(1+\alpha)I-\alpha(G_{\sigma}*I) , enhancing edges and fine details before registering the result as a new image resource.
blocks.zh: 我们用OpenCV的外罩进行磨削。 鉴于量为 α\ alpha , 工具将输入与其高斯- 蓝调版本结合到 I 出 = ( 1 + α ) 我... ... ... ... ... (G \ \ \ \ \ \ \ I),I_{\ mathrm{out}}= (1+\alpha) I-\alpha (G_{\sigma}*I),在将结果注册为新图像资源之前会增强边缘和细微细节.

blocks.en: The executor materializes a registered image as a reference accessible to an external image-to-image search service. It condenses the returned candidate identities, visual matches, source pages, and titles into a textual observation. This tool provides the bridge from a visual anchor to real-world entities and related webpages.
blocks.zh: 执行器实现一个已注册的图像,作为外部图像到图像搜索服务的参考. 它将返回的候选身份、视觉匹配、源页和标题压缩成文字观察。 该工具提供了从可视主播到现实世界实体和相关网页的桥梁.

blocks.en: Text search calls an external search service that performs web retrieval, page reading, and query-focused summarization within one request. Each returned passage retains its title, URL, and summary, enabling identity verification and source-grounded fact acquisition.
blocks.zh: 文本搜索调用一个外部搜索服务,在一个请求中进行网络检索,页面阅读和以查询为重点的汇总. 每个返回的段落都保留其标题、URL和摘要,从而能够进行身份核查并获取来源依据的事实。

blocks.en: This tool operates on the sampled frame grid of a video or an existing clip. For a resource with N N frames, it selects the half-open interval [ s , e ) [s,e) , where 0 ≤ s < e ≤ N 0\leq s<e\leq N , slices the corresponding frame list, and uses FFmpeg to materialize the associated video subclip. The selected frames are re-indexed from zero and registered with the subclip as a new clip resource.
blocks.zh: 这个工具运行在一个视频或已存在的剪辑的被采样帧网格上. 对于有N帧的资源,它选择了半开间距[s, e] [s, e],其中0 s < e → N 0\leq s < e\leq N",切出相应的帧列表,并使用FFmpeg实现相干视频子剪接. 所选框架由零重新索引,并用子剪贴板注册为新剪贴资源.

blocks.en: Given an index 0 ≤ i < N 0\leq i<N , this tool resolves the corresponding frame from the sampled grid and registers it as a new image resource. The returned handle can be passed directly to cropping, OCR, enhancement, and image search, connecting temporal localization to the common image-tool pipeline. Both temporal tools use sampled-grid indices rather than timestamps in seconds.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个索引 0 i < N 0\leq i < N > ,这个工具从被采样的网格中解决相应的框架,并将其注册为新的图像资源。 返回的手柄可以被直接传递到裁剪,OCR,增强和图像搜索,将时间定位连接到常见的图像工具管道. 两种时间工具都使用被采样的网格指数,而不是几秒钟的时间戳.

blocks.en: Malformed calls, invalid resource handles, and out-of-range indices are returned as tool-error observations, allowing the policy to correct them in a later turn. Execution status is retained so that data filtering and reward computation can distinguish successful calls, recoverable errors, and incomplete trajectories.

blocks.en: Appendix D Training and Evidence Reward Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 培训和证据奖励详情

blocks.en: This appendix complements Section 5 with implementation details on supervised trajectory learning, the conversion from task-level VGEGs to EVGR rubrics, and the use of process rewards in GRPO.
blocks.zh: 本附录补充了第5节,详细介绍了受监督的轨迹学习、从任务级的VGEGs转换为EVGR分数以及使用GRPO中的程序奖励。

blocks.en: D.1 Supervised Trajectory Learning
blocks.zh: D.1 监督轨迹学习

blocks.en: SFT uses OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K , comprising approximately 110k expert trajectories: 36k single-image, 37k multi-image, and 35k video trajectories. All three visual input types use the unified multi-turn format defined in Appendix C , where each turn records model reasoning, a tool call, the resulting environment observation, and the subsequent response. Images, video clips, and textual observations returned by tools remain available through resource handles, preserving executable dependencies across tool calls.
blocks.zh: SFT使用OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K,由大约110k的专家轨迹组成:36k单相图,37k多相图,35k相相相图. 所有三种视觉输入类型都使用附录C所定义的统一多转折格式,其中每个转折都记录了模型推理,一个工具调用,由此产生的环境观察,以及随后的反应. 通过工具返回的图像、视频剪辑和文字观察仍可通过资源控件提供,从而保留工具调用中可执行的依赖性。

blocks.en: Visual inputs, user questions, tool definitions, and tool observations serve as conditioning context, while the supervised targets comprise assistant reasoning, tool commands, and final responses. The loss mask is therefore one for policy-generated tokens and zero for environment observations and other conditioning tokens. This prevents the model from being trained to reproduce tool outputs while preserving its ability to condition subsequent actions on executed observations.
blocks.zh: 视觉输入、用户提问、工具定义和工具观察是条件上下文,而受监督的目标包括助理推理、工具命令和最后答复。 因此,损失口罩是用于政策生成的指使,而用于环境观测和其他调节指使,则是零。 这妨碍了该模型在保留其将随后的行动以已执行的观察作为条件的能力的同时,接受复制工具产出的培训.

Videos are sampled at 2 fps with at most 100,352 pixels per frame and 128 frames. SFT uses 64 H800 GPUs across eight nodes and runs for approximately four days.
blocks.zh: 表7报告OneSearch-VL-8B的完整的SFT配置. 我们进行全参数微调,同时冻结视觉编码器和多式投影仪。 视频在2 fps中取样,每个帧最多100,352像素,128帧. SFT使用跨越8个节点的64个H800GPU并运行了约4天.

blocks.en: D.2 Reinforcement Learning Data Construction
blocks.zh: D.2 加强学习数据建设

blocks.en: We construct OneSearch-VL-RL-10K , containing approximately 10k tasks after filtering and deduplication: 3.7k single-image, 2.8k multi-image, and 3.6k video tasks. Candidates are drawn from the corresponding pools for the three visual input types, exposing online training to spatial grounding, cross-image evidence composition, and temporal localization.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了 OneSearch-VL-RL-10K, 包含过滤和分解后大约10克的任务 : 3.7k单相相相,2.8k多相相相相相相,3.6k相相相相相相相相相. 考生从相应的人才库中抽取出三种视觉输入类型,将在线培训暴露于空间地平面,跨图像证据构成,以及时间本地化.

blocks.en: We use Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) to perform eight independent rollouts for each candidate in the unified tool environment and retain tasks satisfying 0 < n correct < 8 0<n_{\mathrm{correct}}<8 , where n correct n_{\mathrm{correct}} denotes the number of rollouts producing a correct final answer. We deduplicate the retained tasks to form the final RL dataset for subsequent GRPO optimization.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Qune3-VL-8B(Bai等,2025年)在统一工具环境中为每个候选人进行8次独立推出,并保留满足 < n 正确 < 8 < n < n > mathrm{ 正确\\\ 8 的任务,其中n正正正正正正正正表示推出次数,得出正确的最终答案. 我们复制保留的任务,形成最后的RL数据集,用于后续的GPRO优化.

blocks.en: D.3 From VGEG Annotations to EVGR Rubrics
blocks.zh: D.3 从VGEG说明到EVGR Rubrics

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , each training item is paired with a structured rubric derived from its task-level VGEG. The rubric retains answer-core entities, required fact hops, supporting sources and snippets, and applicable image, region, or frame locations. The evaluator receives this rubric together with the question, reference answer, visual input type, and serialized executed trajectory, directly aligning the agent’s observations with the evidence required by the task.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,每个培训项目都配有从任务一级VGEG得出的结构化标题。 标题保留了答案核心实体、所需的事实跳出、支持源和片段以及适用的图像、区域或框架位置。 评价人员收到这个标题连同问题、参考答案、视觉输入类型和序列化的已执行轨迹,直接使代理人的观察与任务所要求的证据相一致。

blocks.en: The executed trajectory is serialized in interaction order, including reasoning, tool calls and arguments, and returned observations. For visual-grounding evaluation, the judge additionally receives multimodal inputs alongside the rubric and trajectory records. We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) in two separate calls for evidence traceability and visual grounding, each returning a score and a brief evidence-based explanation.
blocks.zh: 已执行的轨迹按交互顺序进行序列化,包括推理,工具调用和参数,以及返回的观察. 为进行目视定位评价,法官还收到多式输入以及标本和轨迹记录。 我们用"种子2.0 Pro"(ByteDance Seed, 2026 )在两个独立的呼声中分别要求证据可追溯性和视觉地平线,每个回取一个分数和一个基于证据的简短解释.

blocks.en: The judge checks whether tool observations establish the answer-core entities and fact hops required by the rubric and whether subsequent reasoning follows those observations. Missing evidence, unsupported entity substitutions, broken fact chains, and claims that contradict the retrieved sources reduce the score. This dimension evaluates the evidence process independently of an incidental match with the reference answer.
blocks.zh: 法官检查工具观察是否建立了标题所要求的答案核心实体和事实跳跃,以及随后的推理是否遵循了这些观察. 缺少证据,没有支持的实体替代,断裂了事实链条,与被检索来源相矛盾的声称降低了得分. 这个维度独立于与参考答案的偶然匹配来评价证据过程.

blocks.en: The judge checks whether the trajectory identifies the visible entities, regions, or video moments required by the question and uses them to drive subsequent retrieval. For single-image and multi-image inputs, the source images are directly visible to the agent policy, so an additional visual-tool call is not required; the criterion instead checks whether the correct images and objects are used. For videos, the selected frames are compared with the reference moments, and the visual identities obtained from those frames must guide the subsequent evidence search.
blocks.zh: 法官检查轨迹是否识别出问题所需的可见实体,区域或视频瞬间,并使用它们来驱动随后的检索. 对于单图像和多图像输入,源图像直接可见于代理策略,因此不需要额外的可视工具调用;取而代之的标准是检查是否使用了正确的图像和对象. 对于视频,所选取的帧被与参考瞬间相提并论,从这些帧中获得的可视身份必须指导随后的证据搜索.

blocks.en: Using the reward terms defined in the main text, the weights for R acc R_{\mathrm{acc}} , R query R_{\mathrm{query}} , and R EVGR R_{\mathrm{EVGR}} are 0.6, 0.2, and 0.2, respectively, and R fmt R_{\mathrm{fmt}} gates the resulting weighted reward.

blocks.en: Following the main-text setup, we use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Given a group of trajectories sampled for the same question, GRPO derives relative advantages from their within-group rewards and updates the policy with a clipped objective. The policy loss is applied only to model-generated reasoning, tool-command, and final-response tokens, while tool observations remain conditioning context. For trajectories truncated by a terminal tool error, only the valid interaction prefix preceding the failure participates in optimization ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 在主文设置后,我们使用集团相对政策优化(GRPO). 鉴于为同一问题抽样的一组轨迹,GRPO从其内部奖励中获得相对优势,并以被剪切的目标更新了政策. 政策损失只适用于模型生成的推理、工具命令和最后反应符号,而工具观察仍为上下文。 对于被终端工具错误截断的轨迹,只有失败前的有效交互前缀参与优化(Chen等,2026.).

blocks.en: E.1 Multi-image Evidence Composition
blocks.zh: E.1 多图像证据构成

blocks.en: Figure 5 asks for the difference between two manufacturers’ founding years. The agent crops the rear of a blue sports car and identifies a Ford Mustang through ImageSearch , then crops a brake-caliper logo in another image to identify Brembo. TextSearch returns 1903 for Ford and 1961 for Brembo, and the final response computes 1961 − 1903 = 58 1961-1903=58 . The two visual anchors lead to distinct entities and numerical facts, which a subtraction operation combines into the answer, illustrating the dependencies captured by VGEG.
blocks.zh: 图5列出两个制造商创立年份之间的差别。 毒剂在一辆蓝色运动车后部进行收割,通过ImageSearch识别出一辆福特野马,然后在另一个图像中收割出一个刹车-caliper标志来识别Brembo. TextSearch为福特返回了1903年,为布伦博返回了1961年,最终回复计算为1961–1903=58 1961-1903=58. 两个可视主播导致不同的实体和数字事实,一个减法操作结合到答案中,说明了VGEG抓住的依赖性.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Multi-image arithmetic. Separate crops and image searches link the car and brake caliper to Ford and Brembo. Subtracting their retrieved founding years yields 58 years.
blocks.zh: 图5:多相算术. 单独的收成和图像搜索将汽车和制动卡路里与福特和布伦博联系起来. 减掉他们的创立年数是58年。

blocks.en: Figure 6 asks how many car models in three separate images are produced by a company owned by Volkswagen. The agent first crops a logo, identifies Bentley through image search, and retrieves its ownership relation with Volkswagen. It then crops and image-searches each car to identify the Continental-family models and variants, followed by a query about their distinctions. Under the sample’s model/variant counting convention, the final response counts the three pictured cars and returns 3. This case links three visual anchors to an external ownership condition before aggregating the qualifying targets, with all ten tool calls retained.
blocks.zh: 图6 问由大众汽车拥有的公司生产出三个独立图像中有多少个汽车模型. 代理商先是收割出一个标志,通过图像搜索识别出Bentley,并检索其与大众汽车的所有权关系. 之后,它又对每辆车进行作物和图像搜索,以识别大陆-家族模型和变体,然后询问它们的区别。 在样本的模型/变量计数惯例下,最后的回复数计出被描绘出的三个汽车并返回3. 这个案例将3个可视主播与外部所有权条件联系起来,然后汇总合格目标,保留所有10个工具呼叫。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Knowledge-conditioned counting. Three input images and four crops support brand and model identification, followed by counting under a retrieved ownership condition. Image handles match the tool calls.
blocks.zh: 图6:知识型计算。 3个输入图像和4个作物支持品牌和模型识别,然后在检索的所有权条件下进行计数。 图像手柄匹配工具调用.

blocks.en: E.2 Cross-frame Evidence Composition
blocks.zh: E.2 跨框架证据的组成

blocks.en: The following cases retrieve evidence for distinct objects in two and three different frames of the same video, then compare their attributes. Frame strips provide neighboring visual context; blue borders and Used labels mark frames selected by the agent, and ellipses indicate omitted intervals. F denotes a selectable frame index in the benchmark input, not a timestamp in seconds.
blocks.zh: 以下案例在同段视频的两相和三相框中为不同的对象取出证据,然后比较其属性. 框架条提供了相邻的视觉上下文;蓝色边框和由代理商选择的已使用的标签标记框架,椭圆表示省略间隔. F 表示基准输入中可选择的框架索引,而不是秒中的时间戳.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows a video-only SFT checkpoint comparing two toy blasters. The agent selects F9, crops and identifies the Commander RD-6 through image search, and retrieves its release year. It then selects F116 and repeats the crop, image-search, and text-search sequence for the yellow Recon CS-6. Each branch is thus tied to a distinct frame, object, and external attribute. The final response compares the retrieved years 2020 and 2008 and returns 2020, matching the reference answer. The conflicting year summaries in the original trajectory remain visible in the figure.
blocks.zh: 图7显示一个只录相的SFT检查站比较了两个玩具爆破机. 特工通过图像搜索选择了F9,农作物并识别出指挥官RD-6,并取回了它的发布年. 然后它选择了F116并重复了"黄色侦察"CS-6.的裁剪,图像搜索和文本搜索序列. 因此,每个分支都与不同的框架、对象和外部属性相连。 最后答复比较了检索的2020年和2008年,并返回了2020年,与参考答复相匹配。 图中仍然可以看到最初轨迹中相互冲突的年份摘要。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Cross-frame attribute comparison. Blue borders mark selected frames F9 and F116; adjacent frames provide context. Each object undergoes cropping, image retrieval, and text retrieval before release-year comparison. All eight calls and arguments are retained.
blocks.zh: 图7:跨框架属性比较。 蓝色边框标记所选框架F9和F116;相邻框架提供上下文. 每个对象在发布年比较之前都要进行裁剪、图像检索和文本检索。 所有8个电话和论点均予保留。

blocks.en: Figure 8 extends cross-frame retrieval to three anchors. The agent selects F0, F12, and F15, independently crops and image-searches the buildings, and identifies the Chicago Board of Trade, Chicago Temple, and John Hancock Center. For the first building, it enlarges an initially small clock crop before searching. It then retrieves building heights and issues follow-up queries to clarify conflicting values, ultimately returning 1,128 feet, matching the reference. The saved observations retain inconsistent height definitions, and the final response adds an inaccurate antenna height. The trajectory makes the distinction between visual grounding and evidence traceability concrete: the three buildings are independently grounded, while their numerical evidence remains inconsistent.
blocks.zh: 图8将跨帧检索扩展到了三个锚地. 该代理人选择了F0,F12,和F15独立地作物和图像搜索这些建筑,并确定了芝加哥贸易委员会,芝加哥圣殿,和约翰·汉考克中心. 对于第一座建筑,它在搜索之前会拓宽最初的小钟收成. 然后它检索建筑高地并发布后续查询,以澄清相冲突值,最终返回1,128英尺,与参考物相匹配. 所保存的观测保留了不一致的高度定义,而最终的响应增加了不准确的天线高度. 轨迹区分了视觉地平面和证据可追溯性混凝土:这三所建筑是独立的地平面,而其数字证据仍然不一致.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Three-anchor cross-frame retrieval. Blue borders mark selected frames F0, F12, and F15 amid neighboring views. The three buildings are independently image-searched before height comparison. All fourteen calls, crop refinement, follow-up searches, and conflicting observations are retained.
blocks.zh: 图8: 三指架跨帧取回. 蓝色边框在相邻视图中标出所选帧F0,F12和F15. 这三所建筑在高度比较前都要独立地进行图像搜索. 所有14个电话、作物改良、后续搜索和相互矛盾的观察都被保留下来。
